identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1, Open-Label Study Evaluating the Safety, Tolerability and Efficacy of LCAR-C182A, an Anti-Claudin18.2 CAR-T Cell Therapy in Patients With Advanced Gastric Cancer and Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Adverse Events
primaryOutcomes.description: An adverse event is any untoward medical event that occurs in a participant administered an investigational product,and it does not necessarily indicate only events with clear causal relationship with the relevant investigational product.
Maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Transgene Levels of LCAR-C182A CAR-T Cells
primaryOutcomes.description: Transgene Levels of LCAR-C182A CAR-T Cells using sensitive assay methods will be assessed

primaryOutcomes.measure: Chimeric Antigen Receptor T (CAR-T) Positive Cell Concentration
primaryOutcomes.description: Venous blood samples will be collected for measurement of CAR-T positive cellular concentration
Serum cytokine concentrations such as IL-2, IL-6, IL-8, 1L-10, TNF-α, IFN-γ will be measured for biomarker assessment

secondaryOutcomes.description: The ORR is defined as the proportion of patients with complete or partial response according to Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors（RECIST) criteria.

The DOR is defined as the time between the initial onset of complete or partial remission and the onset of disease progression in patients with objective remission according to Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors（RECIST) criteria.
The PFS is defined as the Time from enrollment until disease progression or death according to Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors（RECIST) criteria.
The OS is defined as Time from enrollment until death from any cause according to Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors（RECIST) criteria.
